WITH Rolling_Window AS
(
SELECT * FROM
    (
    SELECT 
		MAX(FullDate) FullDate
    FROM eds.DATE_DIM
        INNER JOIN eds.EDS_CTL
		ON FULLDATE <= TRU_DATE
    WHERE Business_Day_Flag = 'Y'
	AND MONTH_END='Y'
    ) A
)
	SELECT
	
		NONUITF.INVESTMENT_CCY
	FROM 
		EDS.TRU_AUMNONUITF NONUITF
		INNER JOIN 
		Rolling_Window RW
		ON NONUITF.AS_OF_DATE = RW.FULLDATE  
    WHERE PORTFOLIO_NO_UNMASKED = 'AIMA00002456500'
    AND AC_NO  = '0004481003'
    AND SCHEME_CODE = 'SMC2I'
	/*
    GROUP BY
		NONUITF.BASE_NO,
		NONUITF.PORTFOLIO_NO_UNMASKED,
		NONUITF.PF_NO,
		NONUITF.BNK_CODE,
		NONUITF.AS_OF_DATE,
		NONUITF.FOLIO_NO,
		NONUITF.SCHEME_NAME,
		NONUITF.SCHEME_CODE,
		NONUITF.PURCHASED_ON,
		-- Changes in the specs to remove NULL values in value date
		NONUITF.ACTUAL_AS_OF_DATE,
		NONUITF.INVESTMENT_AMT,
		NONUITF.VOLUME,
		NONUITF.HOLDING_UNITS,
		NONUITF.AVG_PRICE,
		NONUITF.SEC_PRICE,
		NONUITF.CURRENT_VALUE,
        NONUITF.AC_NO,
		NONUITF.INVESTMENT_CCY
    */
